system.description:
• Effect: Once per Downtime Phase, or once a week on the road, during a long rest, bleed a spell you know of 3rd level or lower into a vial; its slot doesn't return after that rest.
  • You can have one Draught at a time: an old one spoils when you bleed a new one.
  • The drinker is the spell's only target and gains its effect at your level, as if you had cast it on them.
  • A spell that harms its target or covers an area can't be bled.
